User Role: Assign each user a role: Admin, Builder or End User. User role value should be exact same
Group: Optional. Custom groups as a JSON array e.g. ["Group1","Group2"] (Group1|Group2 also works). Use [] to remove the user from all custom groups. Leave blank to keep existing groups
Metadata: Optional. A JSON object e.g. {"apiKey": "abc123", "apiKey2": "xyz123"}. Leave blank to keep existing metadata
Status: Optional. Active or Archived. Leave blank to keep the current status. Rows whose email already exists in the workspace update that user
